questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

I explained, "I don't belong here."

options.text: I said that I did not belonged here.
I explained that I did not belong there.
I explained that I do not belong there.
I explained that I did not belong here.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **original sentence**, the **speaker is explaining** their feeling of not belonging in a particular place ("I don't belong here").
 
• **In indirect speech,** we **need to use** reporting verbs like "explained" to convey the speaker's words.
 
• In the **indirect form**, we **make changes to the** pronouns, verb tense, and word order.
 
• Here's** an explanation **of why option 2 is the correct answer:
 
• The **reporting verb** "explained" accurately conveys the speaker's action of providing an explanation.
 
• The **pronoun** "I" remains the same to maintain the first-person perspective.
 
• The** verb **"don't belong" **changes to** "did not belong" to reflect the past tense and indirect speech.
 
• The **adverb** "here" **changes to** "there" to indicate the change in location in the reported speech.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"I explained that I did not belong there."*

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The villagers have rebuilt the hospital.

options.text: The hospital was rebuilt by the villagers.
The hospital has been rebuilt by the villagers.
The hospital had been rebuilt by the villagers.
The hospital has rebuilt by the villagers.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In this sentence,** the verb** "have" **in the **active sentence **becomes "has been" in the passive form.
 
• **"Has been" **is the present perfect passive form, indicating an action that started in the past and is still relevant at the present moment.
 
• The word** "rebuilt" **remains the same because it is the past participle form of the verb "rebuild," which is used in the active sentence.
 
• The **subject "the villagers"** in the active sentence **becomes** the agent of the passive sentence, indicated by the preposition "by."
 
• **It shows** that the villagers are the ones who performed the action of rebuilding the hospital.

Therefore, the** correct answer**: *'The hospital has been rebuilt by the villagers'.*
